Alɩf, Lɑɑm, Mɩɩm, Ṣaad.
Yaa gafo b sẽn sik n kõ foom, rẽnd pakr ra wa zĩnd fo sũurẽ wã sẽn kẽed ne-a ye. Sẽn na yɩl tɩ f tall-a n bugsi, la a yaa tẽegr ne sɩd-kõtbã.
Tũ-y bũmb ning b sẽn sik n kõ yãmbã, sẽn yi y Soabã nengẽ wã, la y ra wa tũ lall-n-taas zẽms sẽn pa Yẽ ye. Paood yãmb sẽn tagsd n getẽ.
Lɑ sõor waoog tẽens Tõnd sẽn halke, tɩ Tõnd sɩbgrã wa b nengẽ b yʋng gõeemẽ maa b wĩndg gõeemẽ.
B boolgã pa yɩ bũmb a to, Tõnd namsgã sẽn wa n wa b zugã, rẽnda b sẽn yeele: " ad tõnd yɩɩme n yaa wẽgdba".
Ad Tõnd na n sogsa neb nins Tõnd sẽn tʋms tɩ kẽng b rãmb nengẽ wã, la ad D na n sogsa Tẽn-tʋʋmbã me.
Ad Tõnd na kõ-b kibare ne bãngre, ad Tõnd rag n ka yɩ n lill ye.
La peesgã ra-kãng raarã na n yɩɩ sɩda, rẽnd neb nins yel-sõmd sẽn zɩsge, ad bãmb la põsdba.
La sã n yaa ne neb nins tʋʋm-sõmã sẽn faage, ad yaa bãmb la neb nins sẽn bõn b mense, b sẽn da yɩ n wẽgd Tõnd Aayayã yĩnga.
Ad Tõnd kõo yãmb tõog tẽng poor zugu, la D maan rɩtl n kõ yãmba, lɑ paood yãmb sẽn pʋʋsd barka.
Ad Tõnd naana yãmbɑ, rẽ poorẽ tɩ D sʋʋr yãmba, rẽ poorẽ tɩ D yeel Malεgsa: "maan-y a Adam suguudu". Tɩ b fãa tiuul rẽnda a ɭblɩɩs n tõdge, n pa naag suguud maandbẽ wã.
La Wẽnd yeele: "yaa bõe n gɩdg foom tɩ f maan suguudu M sẽn wa n sagl foomã"? La a yeel yã: "maam n são-a, Fo naana maam ne bugum n naan yẽnda ne tãndo".
La Wẽnd yeel yã: "sig beenẽ, tɩ pa sõmb ne foom tɩ f maan waoog-m-meng beenẽ ye, yi beenẽ tɩ fo yaa yaalga".
La a (ɭblɩɩs) yeele: "yaoolg maam n tɩ tãag Yikr-raarã''.
Tɩ [Wẽnd] yeele: " ad fo naaga b sẽn na n koll-b rãmbã''.
La a ɭblɩɩs yeel yã: "Foom a Wẽnd sẽn rɑɑg maamã, m na n tiim n zĩnd Fo so-tɩrgã zugu, (tɩ b pa tõe n tɑ Foom ye).
Rẽ loogr poorẽ, m na n waa b nengẽ, b taoore, la b poorẽ, la b rɩtg wεεngẽ la b goabg wεεngẽ, F kõn mik b wʋsg tɩ yɑɑ bark pʋʋsdb ye".
La Wẽnd yeel yã: " yi beenẽ, tɩ f yaa b sẽn zange lɑ b sẽn rig ɑ soɑbɑ n zãag yolsgo, ad ned ning sẽn pʋg-a foom bãmbã sʋka, M na pids Gεhannem ne yãmb gilli.
Yaa foom a Adama! kẽ arzãnã foom la f pagã la y rɩ a pʋgẽ yãmb sẽn rat fãa, la y ra kolg tɩ-kãngã n wa lebg wẽg-m-mens rãmb ye".

T'a a Sʋɩtãan wa liib-ba sẽn na yɩl n vẽneg b yãndã n wĩnig-ba, la a (Sʋɩtãan) yeele: " ad yãmb Soabã pa gɩdg yãmb tɩ-kãngã rɩɩbo, rẽndame tɩ yaa sẽn na yɩl tɩ y ra yɩ Malεgs a yiibu maa y ra yɩ paadb ye".
La a wẽename b yiibã yĩngã (n yeele) "ad mam yaa pʋ-peelem soaba y yiibã yĩnga".

T'a Sʋɩtãan sik-b yiibã ne belgre, la wakat ning b sẽn lemb tɩɩgã bilã la b yãnã pãrg n bas-ba, tɩ b lebg n tõsd arzãnã vãad n lut b yãnã, tɩ b Soabã na n bool-ba : " Mam ka gɩdg yãmb n yi tɩ-kãngã, M pa yeel yãmb t'a Sʋɩtãan yaa yãmb y yiibã bε?".
La b yiibã yeele: "yaa d Soaba, ad tõnd wẽga d mense, la tɩ Fo sã n ka yaaf tõnd la F yols tõndo, d nɑ n yɩɩ bõn rãmba".
Tɩ Wẽnd yeele: "sig-y-yã, yãmb ne taab na n yɩɩ beem, y tara Tẽngã pʋgẽ tablg zĩiga la wʋm-noogo n tɩ tãag wakat sẽn yãk toɑɑgɑ".
La Wẽnd yeel yã: "beenẽ (tẽng zugu) la y na vʋɩɩmde, be me la y kiida, be me lɑ b nɑ n yiis-yã".
Yaa yãmb a Adam koamba! Tõnd sika fut n kõ yãmba, sẽn lut yãmb yãnã la faas-teedo. La Wẽn-zoɛɛg fut n yɩɩde, la ad woto yaa sẽn yi Wẽnd tagmasã pʋgẽ, sẽn na yɩlẽ tɩ b tẽegdẽ.

Yaa yãmb a Adam koamba! A Sʋɩtãan ra wa zarb yãmba, wala a sẽn da yiis y rogdb a yiibã arzãnẽ wã ye, n pidg b futã n bas-ba, n na n wĩnig b yiibã b yãnã. Ad yẽ la a buudã nee yãmba, zĩig ning yãmb sẽn pa ne-ba. Ad Tõnd maana Sʋɩtãambã tɩ b yaa lall-n-taas ne neb nins sẽn pa kõt sɩdã.

Lɑ b sã n maan tʋʋm-beed la b sẽn yete:" tõnd mika d yaab-rãmb woto zugu, la yaa Wẽnd n sagl tõnd ne-a". Yeele: "ad Wẽnd pa sagl yel-beed ye. Y na n pasa zĩri-beed n rogl Wẽnd ne bũmb ning yãmb sẽn pa mi?"

Yeele: " mam Soabã sagla ne tẽeg-tɩrga. Lɑ y Maan suguudã tɩ yɩ Wẽnd yĩnga la y yɩlg-y pʋʋsgã ne Wẽnd A ye misr fãa gill pʋgẽ. La y kos-A, tɩ yãmb yaa sẽn yɩlg tũudmã fãa A yĩngɑ. La A sẽn rɑ tõog n naan yãmbã yaa Yẽnd nengẽ la y na n le lebg n tʋge.
Sull n be t'A kãnd-bɑ, la sull me n be tɩ menengã sɩdg b zugu, ad bãmbã rɩka Sʋɩtãansã tɩ yaa b lall-n-taase zẽng tɩ pa Wẽnd ye, la b tẽed tɩ b bee kãndgr zugu.
Yãmb a Adam koamba! Yeelg-y y faas-teedo misr fãa pʋgẽ, la y rɩ la y yũ sẽn yaa yɩlemse, la y ra maan n zʋʋg ye, ad Wẽnd pa nong maan-n-zʋʋg-rãmb ye.

Yeele: "ãnd n gɩdg faas-teed nins Wẽnd sẽn yiis n kõ A yembsã la rɩ-yɩlmã?" yeele: "ad bõn-yɩllmã belmɑ yaa sɩd-kõtbã yĩng dũni vɩɩmã pʋga, la yaa sẽn welg toor zall ne bãmbɑ Yikr-raarã. Yaa woto la Tõnd welsd Aaya-rãmbã n kõt neb sẽn yaa bãngdba.

Yeele: " ad mam Soabã sẽn gɩdgã yaa yel-beedo, sẽn solg la sẽn vẽnege la kedgr tɩ pa tũ ne sɩd ye, la Wẽnd leb n gɩdga y sẽn na n maan lagem-n-taar ne Wẽnde, A sẽn ka sik tɑgmas ɑ zugu, la y sẽn na n yeel Wẽnd zugu yãmb sẽn pa mi".
La zãma fãa tara a raare, b raarã sã n ta, b pa na n yaoolg-b baa bilf ye, b pa na n yãg ne-b me tɩ b sɑsɑ wã pa ta ye.
Yãmb a Adam koambã! Tẽn-tʋʋmb sã n wa wa yãmb nengẽ, n togsd yãmb Mam yel-soalmã, rẽnd neb nins sẽn sak n zoe Wẽnde la b maneg b tʋʋmã, yaeesg ka be bãmb zugu, sũ-sãang me ka na n paam-b ye.
Lɑ sẽn yɑgs-b Tõnd yel-solmã la b maan waoog-m-menga n yi-bã, bãmbã lɑ bugum koɑmbɑ, n na n yɩ paadb ɑ pʋgẽ.

Rẽnd ãnd n le yɩɩd ne wẽgb n le ta ned ning sẽn wãdgɑ n doglg Wẽnd mɑɑ ɑ yɑgs A goɑmã? Bãmbã pʋɩɩrã sẽn be sebrã pʋgã b nɑ n pɑɑm-ɑ-lɑ dũni, hɑl tɩ Tõnd tẽn-tʋmdbã sã n wɑ wɑ b nengẽ n nɑɑ n deeg b yoẽ wã lɑ b sẽn yet-bɑ: ''yãmb sẽn dɑ tũudu-b rãmb zẽng sẽn kɑ Wẽndã bε?'' tɩ b yeele: b menmɑme n bɑs tõndo; lɑ b sɑk n deeg b zugu tɩ bãmb rɑ yɑɑ sõm-zɩtbɑ (Kɩfr-dãmbã).

T'ɑ yeele: kẽ-y (n naag) sul sẽn deng yãmb tɑoore sẽn yɑɑ zĩn-dɑmbɑ lɑ nebɑ bugmã pʋgẽ. sul fãɑ sã n kẽ lɑ ɑ sẽn kãɑbd ɑ to, hɑl tɩ b fãɑ sã n wa pɑɑm tɑɑb ɑ pʋgẽ wã lɑ b pʋgdbã sẽn yet b tɑoor rãmbã: d Soɑbɑ, yɑɑ bãmbã n menes tõndã, bɩ F kõ-b nɑong sẽn fão sẽn yɑɑ bugm, t'A yeele: fãoob n pɑɑs be yem kɑm fãɑ yĩngɑ lɑ yãmb kɑ mi ye.
Tɩ b tɑoor rãmbã yeel b pʋgdbã: yãmb pɑ tɑr yɩɩdlem tõnd zug ye, bɩ y lemb nɑongã y sẽn dɑ tʋmd wẽngã yĩngɑ.

Bãng-y tɩ sẽn yɑgs-b Tõnd goɑmã lɑ b mɑɑn wɑoog-m-meng n bɑs-ɑ wã b kɑ pɑkd sɑɑsã rɑgnoy wã b yĩng ye, lɑ b le kɑ kẽed arzãnã me, hɑl tɩ yʋgemd wɑ tɩ kẽ fu-pĩim võorẽ, lɑ yɑɑ woto me lɑ D rond yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbã.
B tɑrɑ pĩ-gãɑs gεhãnnɑb pʋgẽ, lɑ b tɑr fu-gobs b yĩngrã, lɑ woto me lɑ D rond wẽngdbã.
Lɑ sẽn kõ-b sɩd lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõmɑ wã, Tõnd kɑ rogend yõor rẽndɑ ɑ sẽn tõe, bãmbã lɑ ɑrzãn koɑmbã, b yɑɑ pɑɑdbɑ ɑ pʋgẽ.

Lɑ D yiis beem buud fãɑ sẽn be b sũyẽ wã; tɩ kosoodã zoet b tẽngrã; tɩ b yeele: pẽgr be ne Wẽnde sẽn wilgɑ tõnd sor tɩ d tũ n pɑɑm woto wã, lɑ tõnd rɑ kɑ yɩ n nɑ n bãng sor n tũ sã n kɑ Wẽnd sẽn wilg tõndã yĩngɑ, sɩdɑ tõnd soɑbã Tẽn-tʋʋmbã wɑɑ ne sɩdã. Lɑ b bool-b n yeele: arzãn-kãngã b kõ-ɑ-lɑ yãmbɑ y sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã yĩngɑ.

Lɑ ɑrzãn koɑmbã bool bugum rãmbã n yeel tɩ sɩdɑ tõnd mikɑ d Sobã sẽn pʋlem tõndã tɩ yɑɑ sɩdɑ; lɑ rẽ yĩngɑ yãmb mikɑ y Soɑbã sẽn pʋlem yãmbã tɩ yɑɑ sɩd bɩ? Tɩ b yeel tɩ: Nge; tɩ moond zĩnd b sʋkã n yeele: Wẽnd kãɑb-beed be ne wẽgdbã.
B rãmb nĩns sẽn gɩdgd ne Wẽnd sorã lɑ b rɑt n goɑlem-a wã, n leb n yɑɑ yɑgsdb ne yɑoolem rɑarã.
Lɑ lɑlg n be b ne tɑɑb sʋkɑ, tɩ Lɑlgã zugu neb n be be, b mii ned fãɑ ne b tɑgmase, lɑ b boolɑ ɑrzãn kɑombẽ n yeele: tɩlgr be ne yãmbɑ, bãmb sẽ kɑ kẽ-ɑ ye, lɑ b tẽedɑme.
Lɑ b sã n wẽnemd b nemsã n tees bugmã rɑmb lɑ b sẽn yete: d Soɑbɑ! Rɑ rɩk tõnd n nɑɑg wẽgdbẽ wã ye.
Lɑ lɑlgã-zug rɑmbã boolɑ neb b sẽn mi-b ne b tɑgmasã n yeele: yãmb tigingã lɑ y sẽn dɑ mɑɑnd wɑoog-m-mengã kɑ põsg yãmb ye.
Bãmbã lɑ yãmb sẽn wẽen tɩ Wẽnd kɑ nɑ n kõ-b yolsgã bɩ? Tɩ Wẽnd yeel sɩd-kõtbã kẽ-y ɑrzãnã zɑkã, yεεsg kɑ be ne yãmbɑ, lɑ y sũy me kɑ nɑ n sãɑm ye.
Lɑ bugmã rãmb boolɑ ɑrzãn koɑmbã n yeele: yãk-y koomã mɑɑ wẽnd sẽn dɩlg yãmbã n kõ-do; tɩ b yeele: ɑd Wẽnd gɩdgɑ b yiibã fãa ne sõm-zɩtbã.
Sẽn dɩk-b tũudmã tɩ yɑɑ yõor yɑmleoog lɑ reemã, tɩ ãndũni vɩɩmã belg-bã. Rẽ yĩngɑ D nɑ n yĩm-b-lɑ rũndã wa bãmb me sẽn yĩm rũndã dɑɑrã sεkã lɑ b rɑ yɑgsd Tõnd goɑmã lɑ D yel-soɑlmã.
Lɑ sɩdɑ! Tõnd wɑ b nengẽ ne sebr n wεls-ɑ ne bãngre, t'ɑ yɑɑ peegre lɑ yolsgo, neb nins sẽn kõt-b sɩdã yĩngɑ.

Rẽ yĩngɑ b gũudɑme tɩ kɑ ɑ yɩɩbã? Rɑɑr ningɑ ɑ yɩɩbã sẽn nɑ n wɑ wã, neb nins sẽn dɑg n yĩm-ɑ wã nɑ n yeelɑme: sɩdã, tõnd soɑbã tẽn-tʋʋmbã wɑɑ ne sɩdã; rẽ yĩngɑ tõnd tɑrɑ sugsdb tɩ b na n sugs tõnd yĩng bɩ? mɑɑ b nɑ n lebs-d-lɑme tɩ d tʋm sẽn yõsg tõnd sẽn dɑ tʋmdã bɩ? Sɩdã b bõnɑ b mense, lɑ b sẽn dɑ yɩ n wãdgd n dogendẽ wã menmɑme m bɑs-bɑ.

Bãng-y tɩ yãmb soɑbã lɑ Wẽnd sẽn nɑɑnɑ sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã rɑsem ɑ yoob pʋgẽ, rẽ poorẽ t'ɑ zẽk Al-ʿarsã yĩngri, A pundɑ yʋngã ne wĩndgã tɩ b bɑbsd tɑɑb kʋdɑe, lɑ wĩn-toogã ne ãdsã yɑɑ sẽn nom ne A sɑgelle; rẽ yĩngɑ naanegã lɑ sɑgellã kɑ Yẽ soolem? rẽnd Wẽnd sẽn yɑɑ bũn-nɑɑndsã fãɑ Soɑbã nɑɑm yɩ wɑgell n zẽke.
Bõos-y y Soɑbã ne fĩinig lɑ solgre, ɑd A kɑ nong mɑɑn-n-zʋʋg rãmb ye.
Lɑ-y rɑ sãɑm Tẽngã A sẽn mɑneg-ɑ poor ye, Lɑ y bõos-A ne yεεsg lɑ tẽebo, ɑd Wẽnd yolsgã pẽe ne mɑnegdbã.

Yẽnd n tʋmd sobdã tɩ yɑɑ sũ-noogr ne A yolsgã sẽn yɑɑ sɑ-koomã wɑɑngo, hɑl t'ɑ sã n wɑ peng sɑwɑd-zɩsdo Tõnd pεεgd-ɑ lɑme n kẽng tẽn-kɩɩngẽ n tɩ sik koomã n buls ne-ɑ bõm-biisã fãɑ gilli; yɑɑ woto me lɑ D nɑ n yiis kiidbã tɩ sãnd-sãnde y nɑ tẽege.
Lɑ tẽn-sõng bõn-bundɩ wã bundɑ ne ɑ Soɑbã rɑɑbo, lɑ tẽn-wεεg kɑ bund rẽndɑ yood-yoodo, yɑɑ woto lɑ Tõnd kẽnesd Aɑyɑ wã sẽn pʋʋsd-b bɑrkã yĩngɑ.
Sɩdɑ! Tõnd tʋmɑ ɑ Nuuh ɑ nebã nengẽ, t'ɑ yeele: m nebɑ! tũ-y Wẽnde, yãmb kɑ tɑr soɑb zẽng sẽn kɑ yẽ ye, ɑd mɑm yεεsdɑ rɑ-kẽengã rɑɑr nongã ne yãmbɑ.
T'ɑ nebã pʋgẽ tɑoor rãmbã yeele: ɑd tõnd nee foo tɩ f bee meneng sẽn yɑɑ vẽeng pʋgẽ.
T'ɑ yeele: m nebɑ!, meneng kɑ tɑr mɑɑm ye, lɑ ɑd mɑm yɑɑ tẽn-tʋʋm sẽn yi bõn-nɑɑndsã fãɑ Soɑbã nengẽ.
M tɑɑsdɑ yãmb mɑm Soɑbã tẽn-tʋmdã, lɑ m pelgd m pʋg n sɑgend yãmbɑ, lɑ n mii sẽn yit Wẽnd nengẽ yãmb sẽn kɑ mi.
Yãmb mɑɑndɑ yel-solemd tɩ tẽegr n wɑ yãmb nengẽ sẽn yi yãmb Soɑbẽ wã n wɑ yãmb nengẽ n kõ rɑo sẽn yi yãmb pʋgẽ, bʋɩl yĩng ɑ nɑ bugs yãmb tɩ y bãng n gũus Wẽnde, tɩ sãnd-sãnd B nɑ yols-yã.
Tɩ b yɑgs-ɑ, tɩ Tõnd põsg-ɑ, yẽ ne neb nins sẽn dɑ be ne-ɑ koglgã pʋgã, lɑ D bõr sẽn yɑgs-b Tõnd yel-soalmã, ɑd b yɩɩ pʋ-tẽ-zond-rãmbɑ.
Lɑ D tʋm ɑ Aɑd rãmb nengẽ b sɑɑm-biig ɑ Huud, t'ɑ yeele: m nebɑ! tũ-y Wẽnde, yãmb kɑ tɑr Soɑb zẽng tɩ kɑ Yẽ ye, rẽ yĩngɑ y kɑ nɑ n gũus ne Wẽnde?
A nebã pʋgẽ sẽn yɑ-b sõm-zɩtbã yeelɑme: ɑd tõnd nee foo tɩ f bee yɑlemd pʋgẽ, ɑd tõnd le mii vẽeneg me tɩ fo yɑɑ zĩrĩ-be-nebã pʋgẽ yembre.
T'ɑ yeele: m nebɑ! ɑd yɑlemd kɑ tɑr mɑɑm ye, lɑ sẽn m be bɑlɑ, mɑm yɑɑ b sẽn tʋm ɑ soɑb t'ɑ yi Wẽnd nengẽ n wɑ.
M tɑɑsdɑ yãmb m Soɑbã tẽn-tʋmdã, lɑ m yɑɑ sɑgend sẽn yɑa pʋ-peen-ned ne yãmba.

Yãmb mɑɑndɑ yel-solemd tɩ Tẽegr n wɑ yãmb nengẽ sẽn yi yãmb Soɑbẽ wã n wɑ yãmb nengẽ n kõ rɑo sẽn yi yãmb pʋgẽ, bʋɩl yĩng t'ɑ bugs yãmbɑ, Lɑ y tẽeg A sẽn mɑɑn tɩ yãmb yɑɑ lεdsdb ɑ Nuuh nebã loogr poorẽ, lɑ A le pɑɑs yãmb yɑk naaneg pʋgẽ, bɩ y tẽeg Wẽnd yel-sõmɑ tɩ sãnd-sãnde y nɑ tɩlge.
Tɩ b yeele: fo wɑɑ tõnd nɑ tũ Wẽnd ɑ yembr tãɑ (yĩnga) lɑ d bɑs d bɑ-rɑmbã sẽn dɑ tũudã? bɩ f wɑ ne fo sẽn pʋlemd tõnd ne ɑ soɑbã tɩ f sã n yɑɑ sɩd-soɑbɑ.

T'ɑ yeele: sɩdɑ! nɑong lɑ gẽeg sẽn yi y soɑbã nengẽ pɑɑmɑ yãmbɑ; yãmb wẽedɑ mɑɑm no-koeemd yʋy poorẽ yãmb ne y bɑ-rɑmbã sẽn pʋde, tɩ Wẽnd yɑool n kɑ sik tikr ɑ pʋgẽ? bɩ y gũ tɩ mɑam me nɑɑgɑ yãmb n yɑɑ gũudɑ.
Tɩ Tõnd põsg-ɑ ne neb nins sẽn dɑ be ne-ɑ wã sẽn tũ ne yolsg sẽn yi Tõnd nengẽ, lɑ d kʋʋg sẽn yɑgs-b Tõnd goɑmã lɑ b kɑ yɩ sɩd-kõɑtbã pende.

Lɑ D Tʋm Sɑmuud-rãmb b sɑɑm-biig ɑ Soɑɑlɩh b nengẽ, t'ɑ yeele: m nebɑ! tũ-y Wẽnde, yãmb kɑ tɑr Soɑb zẽng sẽn kɑ Yẽ ye, sɩdɑ vẽenem sẽn yi y Soɑbã nengẽ wɑɑ yãmb nengẽ, woto yɑɑ Wẽnd yʋgemd sẽn yɑɑ yel-solemd yãmb yĩngɑ, bɩ y bɑs-ɑ t'ɑ rɩt Wẽnd tẽn-gãongã zugu, lɑ y rɑ wɑ sɑɑg tɩ wẽng tɑ-ɑ tɩ nɑong sẽn zɑbd wɑ pɑɑm yãmb ye.

Lɑ y tẽeg A sẽn mɑɑn yãmb tɩ y yɑɑ lɛdsdb Aɑd-rãmb loogr poorã, lɑ A sik yãmb tẽngã pʋgẽ tɩ y rɩkd ɑ zĩ-sɑɑlsã n met tugɑ, lɑ y pesd tãmsã n wõgd tɩ lebgd zɑgse, bɩ y tẽeg Wẽnd yel-sõmã lɑ y rɑ gilgd tẽngã pʋgẽ n yɑɑ sãɑmdb ye.

T'ɑ nebã tɑoor rãmbã sẽn mɑɑn-b wɑoog n mengã, yeel ɑ nin-vɑlemsã sẽn kõ-b sɩdã: rẽ yĩngɑ yãmb gãdɑme t'ɑ Soɑɑlɩh yɑɑ b sẽn tʋm ɑ soɑb tɩ yi Wẽnd nengẽ? tɩ b yeele: bãng-y tɩ tõnd yẽ kõo sɩd ne b sẽn tʋm-ɑ ne bũmb ningã.
Tɩ sẽn mɑɑn-b wɑoog-m-mengã yeele: bãng-y tɩ tõnd yẽ yɑɑ yɑgsdb ne yãmb sẽn kõ sɩd ne ɑ soɑbã.
Tɩ b kõs yʋgemdã, lɑ b kɩɩs n bɑs b soɑbã sɑgellã, lɑ b yeele: Soɑɑlɩhʋ, wɑ ne fo sẽn pʋlemd tõndã tɩ f sã n yɑɑ Tẽn-tʋʋmã.
Tɩ miim-kεgengã rɩk-bɑ tɩ b lebg kɩɩmse n wũg b zɑksã pʋsẽ.
T'ɑ bɑll n bɑs-b lɑ ɑ yeele: m nebɑ! sɩdɑ mɑm tɑɑsɑ yãmb m soɑbã toollã, lɑ m mɑɑn pʋ-peelem yãmb yĩngɑ, lɑ yãmb kɑ nong pʋ-peen-nebã ye.
Lɑ f tẽeg Tõnd sẽn tʋm ɑ Lʋʋt, ɑ sẽn wɑ n yeel ɑ nebã: yãmb tʋmdɑ yel-wẽn-kãngã sẽn yɑɑ kẽed-n-tɑɑr ne roɑpã? Ned bɑɑ ɑ ye sẽn kɑ reng yãmb n tʋm ɑ buudu!
Ad yãmb yellã! Yãmb wɑtɑ roɑpẽ ne wʋm-noog n bɑsd pɑgbã, ɑyoo, yãmb yɑɑ neb sẽn yɑɑ mɑn-n-zʋʋg-rãmbɑ, ne yãmb sẽn yi ninsɑɑlemdã todsã, n kɩll n yi yɑm lɑ rog-ne wã sorã.
Lɑ ɑ nebã kɑ tɑll loekr sã n kɑ b sẽn yeele: yiisi-y-bɑ y tẽngẽ wã, ɑd b yɑɑ neb sẽn bɑood yɩlgre.
Tɩ Tõnd tɩlg-ɑ ne ɑ zɑkã rãmbã, sã n kɑ ɑ pɑgã bɑlɑ, ɑ nɑɑgɑ nongã sẽn pɑɑm-b rɑmbã.
Lɑ d sik sɑ-toɑɑg b zugu, bɩ f ges yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbã bɑɑsg sẽn yɩ to-to.

Lɑ d tʋm Mɑdyɑn dãmb nengẽ b sɑɑm-biig ɑ Sʋɑyb, t'ɑ yeele: m nebɑ! tũ-y Wẽnde, yãmb kɑ tɑr Soɑb zẽng sẽn kɑ Yẽ ye. Sɩdɑ, vẽenem yii y Soɑbã nengẽ n wɑ yãmb nengẽ, bɩ y pids vũgbã lɑ zɩslem-mɑgbã, lɑ y rɑ boog nebã b teedẽ wã ye, lɑ y rɑ sãam tẽn-gãongã pugẽ A sẽn mɑnegã poorẽ ye, rẽ lɑ sõmɑ yãmb yĩngɑ tɩ y sã n yɑɑ sɩd-kõɑtbɑ.

Lɑ y rɑ ti sor fãɑ zug n zĩ n bugsd nebã lɑ y gɩt Wẽnd sorã tɩ sẽn dɑtɑ kõn n tũ ye, lɑ y bɑood n nɑ n goɑlem-a bʋɩl yĩng tɩ b rɑ tũ-ɑ ye; lɑ y tẽeg yãmb sõorã sẽn da paood t'A wʋsg-yã, lɑ y ges sãamdbã bɑɑsg sẽn yɩ to-to, ɑ d b bɑɑsgã yɩɩ hɑlkr lɑ bõgsgo.
Lɑ sã n mikɑme tɩ yãmb sãndɑ kõo sɩd ne b sẽn tʋm mɑɑm ne bũmb ningã tɩ sãndɑ kɑ kõ sɩdɑ, bɩ y mɑɑn sugr hɑl tɩ Wẽnd wɑ bʋ d ne tɑɑb sʋkɑ, lɑ Yẽ me n yɩɩd bʋ-bʋʋdbã fãɑ ne sõmblem.

T'ɑ nebã tɑoor rɑmbã sẽn mɑɑn wɑoog-m-mengã yeele: Sʋɑybu, tõnd nɑ n yiisɑ foo ne sẽn nɑɑg-b foo n kõ sɩdã tõnd tẽngẽ wã fɑs, wall tɩ y lebg n wɑ tõnd sorã pʋgẽ, t'ɑ yeele: bɑɑ tɩ tõnd sã n kisg boto?

Tõnd sã n lebg n wɑ yãmb sorẽ wã Wẽnd sẽn tɩlg tõnd tɩ d bɑs-ɑ wã poorẽ, rẽnd tõnd yɑgɑ Wẽnd zĩrĩ; lɑ tõnd kɑ yɩ n nɑ n lebg n wɑ yãmb sorã pʋgẽ tɩ sã n kɑ d Soɑb a Wẽnd n tʋlle, tõnd soɑbã gũbgɑ bũm fãɑ ne bãngre, tõnd boblɑ d meng ne Wẽnde. D soɑbɑ! mɑlg tõnd ne d nebã sʋk ne sɩdɑ, lɑ foo me n yɩɩd bʋ-bʋʋdbã fãa sõmblem.
Lɑ ɑ nebã tɑoor rɑmbã sẽn yɑɑ sõm-zɩtbã yeelɑme: lɑ tɩ yãmb sã n tũ ɑ Sʋɑyb bɩ y bãng tɩ yãmb sɩd yɑɑ bõn dãmbɑ.
Tɩ miimgã pɑɑm-bɑ tɩ b wɑ bɑɑs n wũg b zɑgsẽ wã n yɑɑ yĩn-kɩɩmse.
Neb nins sẽn yɑgs-b ɑ Sʋɑybã yɑɑ wɑlɑ b kɑ tol n zĩnd ɑ pʋgẽ wã meng ye; sẽn yɑgs-b ɑ Sʋɑybã bãmb n yɩ bõnã rãmbɑ.
T'ɑ bɑll n bɑs-b lɑ ɑ yeele: m nebɑ!, sɩdɑ mɑm tɑɑsɑ yãmb y soɑbã Tẽn-tʋmã lɑ m sɑgl-y ne pʋ-peelem, lɑ mɑm nɑ n le sãɑmdɑ m sũur sõm-zɩtb yĩng tɩ bõe?
Lɑ Tõnd kɑ tʋm tɑɑsd tẽngẽ n bɑs n kɑ mɑɑn tɩ keelem lɑ nang tɑ-b ye, bʋɩl yĩng tɩ b nɑ tek n lebge.
Rẽ poorẽ tɩ tõnd tedg wẽngã zĩigẽ n leds sõngã, hɑl tɩ b wɑ fɩɩg n yeele: sɩdɑ, toog lɑ noog buud toor-toor pɑɑma tõnd bɑ-rɑmbã; tɩ Tõnd sɩbg-b ne lingr tɩ b kɑ ning b yɑmẽ ye.
Lɑ lɑ tɩ tẽmsã rãmb sã n dɑ kõẽ sɩd lɑ b gũus b mense, tõnd nɑɑn n pɑkẽ sẽn sõmb kõbg toor-toor tɩ yi sɑɑgẽ wã lɑ tẽngã n kõ-bɑ, lɑ b yɑgsɑme tɩ tõnd sɩbg-bɑ b sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã yĩngɑ.
Tẽmsã rãmb yɑm gãeeme n kɑ yεεsdẽ tɩ Tõnd nɑongã nɑ n wɑ pɑɑm-b tɩ b be gõeem pʋgẽ koe?
Tẽmsã rãmb yɑm gãeeme n kɑ yεεsdẽ tɩ Tõnd nɑongã nɑ n wɑ pɑɑm-b m mik tɩ bãmb reemdɑme koe?
B mɑɑnɑ bɑs-m-yɑm ne Wẽnd nɑongã? Lɑ yɑool n kɑ mɑɑnd bɑs-m-yɑm ne Wẽnd nɑongã rẽndɑ neb nins sẽn yɑɑ bõndbã.
Rẽ yĩngɑ, pɑ vẽneg ne sẽn dɩk-b Tẽngã fɑɑdã b rãmb loogr poorã tɩ Tõnd sã n tʋllẽ D yõkdẽ-b lɑme b tʋʋm-tuuti wã yĩng lɑ D pɑg b sũyã tɩ bãmb kell n pɑ n kɑ reegd sɑgl lɑ?

Tẽn-kãensã, Tõnd togsda foom b yεlã sãndɑ tɩ nɑ yɩ tɑgs-n-gɛsgɑ, lɑ sɩdɑ b tẽn-tʋmdbã wɑɑ b nengẽ ne vẽenesã, lɑ b kɑ yɩ n nɑ n kõ sɩd ne b sẽn yɑgs ne bũmb ning pĩndã ye, yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ Wẽnd pɑgd sõm-zɩtbã sũyã.
Lɑ Tõnd kɑ mik b wʋsgã fãɑ tɩ b pidsd pʋleng ye, lɑ Tõnd sẽn mik yɑɑ tɩ b wʋsgã fãɑ yɑɑ tũudum-yitbɑ.
Rẽ poorẽ Tõnd tʋmɑ ɑ Musɑ ne Tõnd yel-soɑlem-dãmbã t'a kẽng ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon ne ɑ nebẽ wã, tɩ b yɑgs-ɑ; bɩ f ges sãɑmdbã bɑɑsgã sẽn yɩ to-to.
Lɑ ɑ Musɑ yeel ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoonɑ: ɑd mɑm yɑɑ tẽn-tʋʋma sẽn yi bũn-nɑɑndsã fãɑ soɑbã nengẽ.
Sõmbɑme ne mɑɑm tɩ m dɑ yeel n doglg Wẽnd rẽndɑ sɩd bɑlɑ. Sɩdã, mɑm wɑɑ yãmb nengẽ ne vẽenem sẽn yi y soɑbã nengẽ, bɩ f tũnug Ɩsrɑɑyɩɩl kɑmbã ne mɑɑm.
T'ɑ yeele: fo sã n wɑɑ ne yel-solemd bɩ f wɑ ne-ɑ wε, tɩ f sã n yɑɑ sɩd soɑbɑ.
T'ɑ lobg a rasaarã t'a lebg waaf vẽenega.
N yiis a nugã t'ɑ yɑɑ pεεlg tɩ b getẽ.
T'ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon nin-bεdã yeele: ɑd yãoã yɑɑ tɩɩm-soɑb sẽn yɑɑ mitɑ.
N dɑt n yiis yãmb y tẽngẽ wã, lɑ yãmb neeme tɩ d mɑɑn wãnɑ?
Tɩ b yeele: "yɑool-ɑ ne ɑ tãoã raoogo, lɑ f tʋm tẽmsã pʋsẽ tɩ b tigim nebã".
N wɑ ne fo nengẽ tɩɩm-soɑb fãɑ sẽn yaa mitɑ.
Lɑ tɩ-mɑɑndbã wɑa ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon nengẽ n yeele: keoor nɑ zĩnd tõnd yĩng tɩ tõnd sã n tõoge?
T'ɑ yeele: n-ye, lɑ ɑd yãmb nɑ n lɑgmɑ pẽnegdbã.
Tɩ b yeele: Musɑ, fo reng n lobe, mɑɑ tɩ tõnd lobe.
T'ɑ yeele: lob-y-yã; lɑ b sẽn wɑ n lobã b mɑɑnɑ nebã nin tɩɩm, lɑ b mɑɑn-b rɑbeem, lɑ b wɑ ne tɩɩm sẽn bedme.
Tɩ Tõnd tʋm tɩ kẽng ɑ Musɑ nengẽ tɩ : lobg f rɑ-sɑɑrã, t'ɑ tɑr b zĩri-beedã volb bɑlɑ.
Tɩ sɩdã wili, tɩ b sẽn dɑ mɑɑndã be sãɑngẽ.
Tɩ b tõog-b be, tɩ b lebg tɩ b yɑɑ yɑɑlse.
Tɩ tɩ-mɑɑndbã lʋɩ tɩ b yɑɑ tiuudbɑ n mɑɑn Sʋguudu.
B yeelɑme: "d kõo sɩd ne bõn-naandsã Soabã,
A Musɑ ne a Harʋʋn Soabã".
T'ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon yeele: yãmb kõo sɩd ne-ɑ tɑoor tɩ mɑm kɑ kõ yãmb sore? Ad yãoã yɑɑ rɑbɑ yãmb sẽn wʋg tẽngã pʋgẽ n rɑt n yiis ɑ rãmbã ɑ pʋgẽ, lɑ y nɑ bãnge.
Lɑk m nɑ kʋʋs yãmb nusã ne y nɑoã loɑndɑ, rẽ poorẽ lɑk m nɑ sẽb-y n sãr-y gill kεp.
Tɩ b yeele: ɑd tõnd yɑɑ d soɑbã nengẽ lebdbɑ.
Lɑ fo kɑ sɩbgd tõnd sã n kɑ tõnd sẽn kõ sɩd ne d soɑbã yel-soɑlmã, b sẽn wɑ n wɑ tõnd nengẽ wã yĩng bɑlɑ; d soɑbɑ: kõ-d sug-norgo lɑ f reeg d yõe wã tɩ d yɑɑ sɑk-n-tũ-rãmbɑ.

Lɑ ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon nin-gĩinã yeel yã: fo nɑ n bɑsɑ ɑ Musɑ ne ɑ nebã tɩ b sãɑm tẽngã pʋgẽ lɑ b bɑs foo ne f rʋbsã? T'ɑ yeele: d nɑ n kʋʋ b kɑm-dibli wã lɑ d bɑsd b pɑgbã, lɑ ɑd tõnd yɑɑ pang tõogdb b zugu.
T'ɑ Musɑ yeel ɑ nebã: bõos-y Wẽnd sõngr lɑ y mɑɑn sugri; ɑd tẽngã yɑɑ Wẽnd n so n lεdsdɑ ɑ sẽn dɑt b rãmb A yembsã pʋgẽ, lɑ yɑoolem neerã yɑɑ gũus-m-mengã rãmb yĩngɑ.
La b yeel yã: tɑoor tɩ fo nɑn kɑ wɑ tõnd nengẽ b nɑmsɑ tõndo, lɑ fo wɑoongã me poorẽ; t'ɑ yeele: yãmb soɑbã tõeeme n wõrg yãmb bε wã lɑ ɑ leds yãmb tẽngã pʋgẽ n ges yãmb sẽn nɑ n tʋm to-to.
Lɑ sɩdɑ tõnd sɩbgɑ ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon nebã ne yʋʋm-kãogs (wɑre) lɑ ti-biis boogr tɩ sãnd-sãnde b nɑ tẽeg n tek n bɑse.

Lɑ sẽn sõmbã sã n wɑ b nengẽ lɑ b sẽn yet tɩ wã yɑɑ tõnd rẽndɑ; lɑ wẽng sã n pɑɑm-b lɑ b sẽn yet t'ɑ Musɑɑ ne neb nins sẽn be ne-ɑ wã zu-beedã n pɑɑm bãmbã; b zu-beedã yɑɑ Wẽnd nengẽ bɑl lɑ be, lɑ b wʋsgã fãɑ kɑ mi ye.
Lɑ b yeele: bɑɑ fo sẽn wɑt ne yel-soɑlem to-to fãɑ n nɑ n gɑɑm tõnd ne-bɑ, tõnd kɑ sɩd-kõɑtb ne foo ye.
Tɩ Tõnd sɩbg-b ne ko-rukɑ lɑ sʋyɑ lɑ kɑrense lɑ poɑndɑ lɑ zɩɩm tɩ yɑɑ yel-soɑlem sẽn yɑɑ vẽenese n pʋg tɑɑbɑ, tɩ b mɑɑn wɑoog-m-meng lɑ b yɩ neb sẽn yɑɑ yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbɑ.
Lɑ nɑongã sẽn wɑ m pɑɑm-bã b yeelɑme: Musɑ! bõos f soɑbã ɑ sẽn pʋlem foo wã, lɑ tɩ fo sã n zẽk nɑongã n bɑs tõndo, d nɑ kõ sɩd ne foo, la d nɑ bɑs ɑ ɭsrɑɑyɩɩl kɑmbã tɩ b tũ foo.
Lɑ Tõnd sẽn wɑ n zẽk nɑongã n bɑs-b n nɑ n tɑll n tãɑg sɑsɑ ning bãmb sẽn nɑ n tɑ-ɑ wã, lɑ sẽn mik tɩ b yidgdɑ pʋlemdã.
Tɩ Tõnd sɩbg-b n bõr-b mogrã pʋgẽ, b sẽn yɑgs tõnd goɑmã lɑ d yel-soɑlmã, lɑ b rɑ yɑɑ yɑm yɑɑl-yɑɑl-rãmb ne-ɑ wã yĩngɑ.

Lɑ D kõ neb nins b sẽn dɑ fɑɑgdã Tẽngã wĩndg sẽn pukdẽ lɑ ɑ sẽn lʋɩtẽ fɑɑdo, Tõnd sẽn bɑrk tẽns ninsã (Sɑɑm); lɑ f Soɑbã pʋlem-sõng gomdã sɩdgɑ ɑ ɭsrɑɑyɩɩl kɑmbã zugu, b sẽn mɑɑn sugrã yĩngɑ; lɑ D bõgs ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon ne ɑ nebã sẽn dɑ mɑɑndã lɑ b sẽn dɑ met lɑ b tiidã.

Lɑ Tõnd gãngɑ ne ɑ Ɩsrɑɑyɩɩl kɑmbã mogrã tɩ b kẽn n tɩ mik neb sẽn tɑbend ne b rʋbs tũudum, tɩ b yeele: Musɑ! bɑo soɑb sẽn yɑɑ rʋbgɑ n kõ tõnd me wɑlɑ bãmbã sẽn tɑr soɑben-dãmb sẽn yɑɑ rʋbsã, t'ɑ yeele: ɑd yãmb yɑɑ zɩtbɑ.
Bãng-y tɩ bãmbã sẽn be bũmb ning pʋgã yɑɑ sẽn bõgse, lɑ b sẽn dɑ tʋmdã me yɑɑ zɑɑlem fɑs.
A yeelɑme: zẽng sẽn kɑ Wẽnd lɑ mɑm nɑ n bɑo n kõ yãmb tɩ yɩ y soɑb tɩ yɑool n yɑɑ Yẽ n yɩɩs yãmb y zãmɑɑnã rãmb fãɑ zugu?

Lɑ y tẽeg Tõnd sẽn wɑ n põsg yãmb n yi ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon nebã, b sẽn sɩbgd yãmb sɩbgr tεk-tεkẽ, n kʋʋd y kom-dibli lɑ b bɑsd y kom-pugli wã, lɑ yel-kãngã pʋgẽ wã ɑd zɑrb-n-gεsg kẽeng sẽn yi y soɑbã nengẽ be be.

Lɑ Tõnd kõ ɑ Musɑ sεk yʋnd pis-tã, lɑ D le pɑɑs-ɑ piigɑ, t'ɑ soɑbã sεkã pid yʋnd pis-nɑɑse; lɑ ɑ Musɑ yeel ɑ tão wã ɑ Hɑɑrʋʋn: led mɑm zĩigẽ m nebẽ wã, lɑ f mɑlg sẽn nɑ mɑlg fãɑ, lɑ f rɑ tũ sãɑmdbã sor ye.

Lɑ ɑ Musɑ sẽn wã n wɑ Tõnd sεkã yĩngã t'ɑ Soɑbã gom ne-ɑ wã ɑ yeelɑme: m Soɑbɑ! wilg-m tɩ m yã Fo, t'A yeele: fo kɑ nɑ n tol n yã Mɑɑm ye, lɑ ges tãngã tɩ sã n mik t'ɑ tõog n tɑbl ɑ zĩigẽ wã, rẽnd f nɑ n yãa Mɑɑm. Lɑ ɑ Soɑbã sẽn wɑ n zɩsg tãngã kɩtɑme tɩ tãngã bõgse, t'ɑ Musɑ lʋɩ n sobge, lɑ ɑ sẽn wɑ n vʋʋgã ɑ yeelɑme : yɩlgemd be ne Foo, ɑd mɑm tuub n tʋg Fo nengẽ, lɑ mɑɑm lɑ sɩd-kõɑtbã rẽenem soɑbã.
T'A yeele: Musɑ! Ad Mɑm tũusɑ foom nebã zugu ne M tẽn-tʋmdã lɑ M goɑmã; bɩ f reeg Mɑm sẽn kõ-fã, lɑ f yɩ bɑrk pʋʋsdɑ.

Lɑ Tõnd gʋlsɑme n kõ-ɑ Wɑlsã pʋgẽ bũmb lɑ yell fãɑ tɩ yɑa sɑglg lɑ welsgo; bɩ f reeg-ɑ ne yẽesem lɑ nidg pãngɑ lɑ f sɑlg f nebã tɩ b reeg-ɑ sẽn tɩ yɑɑ sõmɑ n tɩ yɩɩdã, Mɑm nɑ n wilgɑ yãmb tũud-bɑsdbã bɑɑs-beedã.

M nɑ n wẽnemsɑ M yel-soalmã n bɑs neb nins sẽn mɑɑnd wɑoog-m-meng tẽngã pʋgẽ tɩ kɑ yɩ ne sɩdã, lɑ b sã n yẽ yel-solemd fãɑ b kɑ kõt-ɑ sɩdã, b sã n yẽ kãndgrã sorã b kɑ rɩkd-ɑ n mɑɑn b sorã, la b sã n yaool n yẽ kedgrã sorã b rikd-ɑ lame tɩ yɑɑ sore. Lɑ rẽ fãa yɑɑ b sẽn yɑgs Tõnd yel-soalmã lɑ b rɑ yɑɑ yɑm yɑɑl-yɑɑl rãmb ne-ɑ wã yĩngɑ.
Lɑ neb nins sẽn yɑgs Tõnd yel-solem-dãmbã lɑ yɑoolem dɑɑrã, b tʋʋmã sãɑmɑme; rẽ yĩngɑ b rond-b lɑme n zʋʋg b sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã?

Lɑ ɑ Musɑ nebã rɩkɑ b nɑg-teedã n yag lull t'ɑ tɑr yĩng la yãsr n mɑɑnd bʋʋre, n rɩk-a n mɑɑn b Soɑbɑ, rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ ne t'ɑ kɑ gomd ne bãmb lɑ ɑ le kɑ tõe n wilg bãmb so-tɩrg tɩ b rɩk lɑ? B rɩk-ɑ lɑme n mɑɑn b soɑbɑ, lɑ b yɩɩme n yɑɑ wẽgdbɑ.
Lɑ b sẽn wɑ n bãng tɩ bãmb kẽe bõn pʋgẽ wã tɩ b mɑɑn nimsã, n yẽ tɩ bãmb sɩd menmɑme wã b yeelɑme: lɑk tɩ tõnd Soɑbã sã n kɑ yols tõnd lɑ A bɑs tɩ loog tõnd yĩngɑ, tõnd nɑ yɩ bõn rãmba.

Lɑ ɑ Musɑ sẽn wɑ n lebg n wɑ ɑ nebẽ wã t'ɑ yɑɑ sẽn gẽ t'ɑ sũur sãɑme, ɑ yeelɑme: yell ning yãmb sẽn yõd n mɑɑn mɑm loogrã poorã yɑɑ yel-wẽnd meng-mengɑ; yãmb gesɑme tɩ yãmb Soɑbã yellã kɑoosdɑme lɑ? T'ɑ bɑs wɑlsã tɩ lʋɩ lɑ ɑ gãd ɑ tãoã zug n veoogd-ɑ n kolgd ɑ mengã; t'ɑ yeel-ɑ : m mɑ-biigɑ! Ad nebã vɑlemsɑ mɑɑm lɑ b rɑg n pʋs n dɑ nɑ n kʋ mɑɑm; bɩ f rɑ mɑɑn tɩ bεεb lɑm ye, lɑ f rɑ wɑ nɑɑg-m wẽgdbẽ wã ye.
T'ɑ yeele: m Soɑbɑ! yɑɑf m yĩng lɑ F yɑɑf m yɑoã, lɑ F kẽes tõnd F yolsgã pʋgẽ, lɑ yɑɑ Foo n yɩɩd yoɑlsdbã fãɑ ne yolsgo.
Bãng tɩ neb nins sẽn dɩk lullã n mɑɑn b soɑbã, gẽeg lɑ fɑɑgr sẽn yi b Soɑbã nengẽ n nɑ n pɑɑm-bɑ, lɑ yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ D rond pɑs-n-doglã rãmbɑ.
Lɑ neb nins sẽn tʋm tʋʋm-wẽnã n tek n lebg rẽ loogr poorã lɑ b kõ sɩdã, bãng tɩ fo Soɑbã rẽ loogr poorẽ ɑ yɑɑ bãn-lut ( yɑɑfdɑ) n yɑɑ yoɑlsdɑ.
Lɑ gẽegã sẽn wɑ n loog n bɑs ɑ Musɑ wã ɑ rɩkɑ wɑlsã, tɩ be ɑ gʋlbẽ wã kãndgr lɑ yolsg ne neb nins sẽn yεεsd b soɑbã.

Lɑ ɑ Musɑ tũusɑ rɑop pis-yopoe ɑ nebã pʋgẽ Tõnd sɛkɑ yĩngɑ, lɑ rigimdgã sẽn wɑ n pɑɑm-bã ɑ yeelɑme: m Soɑbɑ! fo sã n dɑ rɑtɑ Fo nɑɑn n hɑlk bãmb ne mɑɑm fãɑ pĩndɑ, Fo nɑ n hɑlkd tõndo yɑlemsã sẽn be tõnd pʋgẽ wã tẽn-tʋmdɩ wã yĩngɑ? Rẽ yɑɑ Fo zɑrb-n-gesgɑ tɩ Fo tɑr-ɑ n menesd F sẽn dɑt-b rãmbɑ, lɑ F peegd F sẽn dɑt-b rãmbɑ, Foo lɑ tõnd lɑlldɑ, bɩ F yɑɑf tõnd yĩng lɑ F yols-do, lɑ Foo me n yɩɩd yɑɑfdbã fãɑ ne sõmblem.

Lɑ F kõ-d sẽn sõmb dũni lɑ yɑoolem dɑɑrã, ɑd tõnd tek n lebg n tʋgɑ Fo nengẽ; t'ɑ yeele: Mɑm naongã M sɩbgdɑ M sẽn dɑt ɑ soɑb ne-ɑ, lɑ Mɑm yolsgã gũbgɑ bũmbã fãɑ, lɑ Mɑm nɑ n kõ-ɑ-lɑ neb nins sẽn gũusd b mens lɑ b kõt Zɑkã, lɑ neb nins sẽn kõt sɩd ne Tõnd yel-soalmã.

Neb nins sẽn pʋgd Tẽn-tʋʋmã sẽn yɑɑ tɑɑsdã n yɑɑ zu-sɑbellã, bãmb sẽn mikd tɩ b gʋls ɑ soɑb yell bãmb nengẽ wã tɑoorɑɑtã lɑ ĩngiilã pʋgẽ, n sɑgend bãmb ne mɑnegrã, lɑ ɑ gɩdgd-b ne yel-kitɩ, lɑ ɑ kõt-b sor ne yel-yɩlmã, lɑ ɑ gɩgd-b ne bõn-rẽgdã, lɑ ɑ rokd b zɩɩbã lɑ yel-gĩtɩ wã n bɑsd-bã; rẽnd neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd ne-ɑ wã lɑ b zɩsg-ɑ lɑ b sõng-ɑ lɑ b tũ vẽenem ning b sẽn sik n tũnug-ɑ wã, bãmbã lɑ tɩlgdbã.

Yeele: nebɑ! Ad mɑm yɑɑ Wẽnd tẽn-tʋʋm n tʋg y fãɑ nengẽ; sẽn so sɑɑs lɑ Tẽng nɑɑmã, soɑb sẽn nɑ n tũ n tɩlg kɑe rẽndɑ Yẽndɑ, A vʋʋgdɑme lɑ A kʋʋdɑ; bɩ y kõ sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ A tẽn-tʋʋmã, sẽn yɑɑ Nɑbiyɑɑmã (Kibɑ-tɑɑsdã), n yɑɑ zu-sɑbelle, sẽn kõtɑ sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ A goɑmã; lɑ y tũ-ɑ sãnd-sãnde y nɑ pɑɑm peegre.
Lɑ ɑ Musɑ nebã pʋgẽ neb n be be n wilgd sɩdã sore, lɑ b bʋʋd ne-ɑ.

Lɑ Tõnd sẽeg-b-lɑ buud piig lɑ ɑ yiibu, tɩ b yɑɑ sul toor-toore; lɑ Tõnd tʋms ɑ Musɑ nengẽ, ɑ nebã sẽn wɑ n bõos-ɑ t'ɑ kos koom n kõ-bã, t'ɑ ''wẽ kugrã ne f rɑsɑɑrã'', tɩ ko-nin piig lɑ ɑ yiib pus n yit beenẽ, tɩ ned kɑm fãɑ bãng ɑ yũub zĩigɑ, lɑ D lud-b ne sɑwɑto, lɑ D sik tɑmɑ-sɩɩd lɑ pʋt-n-lʋɩyɑ (tãntãn-noog) n kõ-bɑ. Rɩ-y rɩ-yɩlmã Tõnd sẽn dɩlg yãmbã; lɑ b pɑ wẽg Tõnd ye, lɑ ɑd b rɑ yɩɩme n wẽgd b mensã.

Lɑ sɑsɑ ning b sẽn wɑ n yeel-b tɩ: zĩnd-y tẽn-kãngã pʋgẽ lɑ y rɩ yãmb sẽn dɑt ɑ pʋgẽ, lɑ y yeele: bɑs tɩ loog d yĩngɑ, lɑ y kẽ rɑg-noorã ne sulgr tɩ yɑɑ sɑk-n-tũ ne Wẽnde tɩ D nɑ yɑɑf y tʋʋm-tuuti wã y yĩngɑ, D nɑ n pɑɑsɑ mɑɑn-neerã rãmbɑ.
Tɩ neb nins sẽn wẽg-bã tedg gom-bill tɩ yõsg ne b sẽn yeel-b tɩ b yeelã, tɩ Tõnd tʋm sɩbgr tɩ yi sɑɑsẽ wã n pɑɑm-bɑ b sẽn dɑ wẽgdã yĩngɑ.

Lɑ sok-b tẽng ning sẽn dɑ be mogrã kɩrengã yelle, wɑkɑt ning b sẽn dɑ kɩɩsd n yẽed zĩmã sibrɑ rɑɑrã, bɑlɑ b zĩmã rɑ wɑtɑ b nengẽ b Sibrã dɑɑre n dɑeedɑ (vẽeneg-vẽengɑ), lɑ rɑɑr ning b sẽn kɑ vʋʋsdã sẽn pɑ Sibrã, b kɑ wɑt b nengẽ ye, yɑɑ woto lɑ D zɑrbd-b n gεtẽ b sẽn dɑ yɩ n yit n bɑsd tũudmã yĩngã.

Lɑ sɑsɑ ningɑ b pʋgẽ wã neb sãndɑ sẽn wɑ n yeele: ''yɑɑ bõe tɩ yãmb sɑgend neb Wẽnd sẽn nɑ n wõr-b mɑ A nɑms-b nɑong kãnkãe? tɩ b yeele: yɑɑ pɑdeng ne tõnd n tʋg y soɑbã nengẽ lɑ sãnd-sãnd me b nɑ gũusi.
Lɑ b sẽn wɑ n yĩm b sẽn bugs-b ne bũmb ningã Tõnd põsgɑ sẽn gɩdgd-b wẽngã lɑ D yõk sẽn wẽg-bã ne nɑn-kεgeng b sẽn dɑ yɩ n yit tũudmã yĩngɑ.
Lɑ b sẽn wɑ n kɩɩs n zʋʋg b sẽn gɩdgb ne bũm ningɑ Tõnd yeel-b lɑme: lebg-y wãɑmbs n yɑɑ yɑɑlse.
Lɑ tẽeg sɑsɑ ning fo Soɑbã sẽn wɑ n wilg t'A nɑ n tʋmɑ b zug sẽn nɑ n sɩbg-ɑ bãmb sɩbg-wẽng hɑl n tãɑg yikrã-rɑɑre, ɑd fo Soɑbã yɑɑ sɩbg-tʋʋll soɑbɑ, lɑ ɑd A leb n yɑɑ bãn-lut n yɑɑ yolsdɑ.
Lɑ Tõnd sẽeg-b-lɑ tẽngã pʋgẽ sull-sulli, nin-sõmɑ be b pʋgẽ, sẽn kɑ boto me be b pʋgẽ, lɑ Tõnd zɑrb-b-lɑ ne yel-nood lɑ yel-tood tɩ sãnd-sãnde b nɑ tek n lebge.

Tɩ ledsdb leds b loogrã poorẽ n rɩk gɑfã fɑɑdo n deegd dũni wʋm-noogã sẽn yɑɑ yɑɑlgã, lɑ b yetẽ tɩ b nɑ n ludɑ bãmb yĩngɑ; lɑ wʋm-no-kãng buud sã n wɑ b nengẽ lɑ b sẽn deegd-ɑ. Rẽ yĩngɑ b kɑ reeg gɑfã pʋleng bãmb zug tɩ b rɑ yeel n dogl Wẽnd tɩ sã n kɑ sɩdã, lɑ bãmb yɑoolẽ kɑrmɑ sẽn be ɑ pʋgẽ wã? Lɑ yɑoolem zɑkã lɑ sõmɑ n yɩɩd ne gũus-m-meng rãmbã; rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ nɑ n kõ b mens yɑm?
Lɑ neb nins sẽn gãd-b sebrã lɑ b yɑls pʋʋsgã, b bãng tɩ Tõnd kɑ yeebd mɑlgdbã rolbã ye.

Lɑ tẽeg Tõnd sẽn wɑ n zẽk tãngã b zugẽ wã t'ɑ yɑɑ wɑlɑ sɑwɑdg tɩ b sãmb t'ɑ nɑ n lʋɩ n yẽeg-b lɑme n yeel-bɑ: reeg-y Tõnd sẽn kõ yãmb bũmb ningã ne y sũyã fãɑ-fãɑ, lɑ y tẽeg sẽn be ɑ pʋgẽ wã tɩ y nɑ bãng n gũus y mense.

Lɑ sɑsɑ ning fo Soɑbã sẽn wɑ n yiis ɑ Aɑdɑm kɑmbã b pεlẽ wã lɑ A reeg b kɑset b mensã zug n yeel-bɑ: ''pa Mɑɑm lɑ yãmb Soɑb sɩda? tɩ b yeele: ''N-ye, d mɑɑnɑ kɑseto''; lɑ yɑɑ bʋɩl yĩng tɩ y rɑ wɑ yeel yikrã rɑɑre: ''ɑd tõnd rɑ kɑ bãng wã ye''.
Mɑɑ tɩ y yeel: ''ɑd yɑɑ tõnd bɑ-rɑmbã n dɑ mɑɑn lɑgem-n-tɑɑr pĩndɑ, lɑ tõnd yɑɑ b kɑmbɑ b loogr poorẽ, rẽ yĩngɑ F nɑ n yõkɑ tõnd ne sãɑm-dãmbã ( sãɑmdbã)sẽn tʋmã?
Lɑ yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ Tõnd welsd D yel-soalmã, tɩ sãnd-sãnde b nɑ tek n lebg.
Lɑ kɑrem n togs-b ned ning kibɑr Tõnd sẽn kõ Tõnd yel-soalmã bãngrã t'ɑ foog ɑ meng n yi-b t'ɑ sʋɩtãɑn rɑɑgɑ t'ɑ yɩ kɛdgdɑ.

Lɑ Tõnd sã n dɑ tʋllẽ, D nɑɑn n zẽk-ɑ ne-bɑ; lɑ bʋko ɑ tũu dũni n tũ ɑ yõorã yɑmleoogo; rẽnd ɑ bilg-n-tɑɑr yɑɑ wɑ bɑɑgɑ, fo tʋm-ɑ (t'a zoetẽ) ɑ sehdɑme, f kɑ tʋm-ɑ (t'a yasẽ bala) ɑ sehdɑme, boto lɑ sẽn yɑgs-b tõnd yel-soɑlmã bilgri, bɩ f tẽeg kʋdemd n togs-bɑ, tɩ sãnd-sãnde b nɑ tɑgs n gese.
Sẽn yɑgs-b Tõnd yel-soɑlmã bilg-n-tɑɑr yɩ wẽngɑ, lɑ b rɑ yɩɩme n wẽgd b mensã.
Neb nins Wẽnd sẽn peeg-b rãmbã, bãmb n bãngd sorã n dɩke, lɑ Wẽnd sẽn menes-b rãmbã, bãmb me lɑ bõn-rãmbã.

Lɑ sɩdɑ! Tõnd nɑɑnɑ zĩn-dãmb lɑ neb wʋsg ghεhãnnɑm yĩngɑ, b tɑrɑ sũyã n kɑ tɑr-b n tɑgsdẽ ye, lɑ b tɑr nin n kɑ tɑr-b n neẽ ye, lɑ b tɑr tʋb n kɑ tɑr-b n kelgdẽ ye, bãmbã yɑɑ wɑlɑ rũmsi, bãmb n pʋs n yɩɩd menengo, bãmb lɑ yɑm yɑɑl-yɑɑlã-rãmbɑ.
Lɑ Wẽnd n tɑr yʋy sẽn yɑɑ sõmɑ, bɩ y kos-A ne-bɑ, lɑ y bɑs sẽn wẽnd-b A yʋyã, b nɑ n dol-b-lɑ b sẽn dɑ tʋmdã.
Lɑ bõn-nɑɑndsã Tõnd sẽn nɑɑnã pʋgẽ zãmɑ wʋsg n be be n peegdẽ n tʋgd so-tɩrgã ne sɩdɑ, lɑ yɑɑ yẽ me lɑ b rɩkdɑ.
Lɑ sẽn yɑgs-b Tõnd yel-soɑlmã D nɑ n yõk-b-lɑ b sẽn kɑ tẽedẽ.
la M yaoond-ba, ad Mam rabrã kegmame.
Bãmb kɑ tɑgs lɑ? gẽemd kɑ tɑr yãmb nedã dε, ɑ kɑ yɩ rẽndɑ bugsd sẽn yɑɑ vẽengɑ.
Bãmb kɑ tɑgesd n ges Wẽnd soolem sẽn be sɑɑsẽ lɑ tẽng pʋgẽ wã lɑ? bɩ Wẽnd sẽn nɑɑnã buud fãɑ la? B le kɑ ges me tɩ tõe tɩ b sɑsa wã kolgɑme lɑ? Yɑɑ gom-bʋs lɑ b nɑ n kõ sɩd Alkʋrãɑn loogr pooẽ?
Wẽnd sẽn menes-b rãmbɑ, pεεgd kɑ be ye, lɑ ɑ bɑs-b tɩ b be menengã pʋgẽ n tuumdẽ.

B sokdɑ foo dũni-yikr sɑsa wã yelle, tɩ yɑɑ sɑsɑ bʋg lɑ ɑ nɑ n yɩ? Yeele: ''ɑ bãngrã bee m Sõɑbã nengẽ, kɑ vẽnegd ɑ sɑsɑ wã n bãng rẽndɑ Yẽ, ɑ yellã solgɑme n pɑk sɑɑsẽ lɑ tẽng rãmbẽ, ɑ kɑ nɑ n wɑ pɑɑm yãmb rẽndɑ ne lingri''. B sokdɑ foom ɑ yellã tɩ yɑɑ wɑ ɑ bãngrã yell pɑkɑ foo (yɑɑ wɑ f miẽ-ɑ lɑme), yeele: ''ɑ bãngrã yɑɑ Wẽnd nengẽ bɑl lɑ be, lɑ nebã wʋsg fãɑ kɑ mi ye''.

Yeele: ''mɑm kɑ so n meng n kõt m meng sẽn tɑr yõod mɑɑ m zãagd m meng ne sẽn yɑɑ wẽeng ye, sã n kɑ Wẽnd sẽn tʋlle; lɑ mɑm sã n dɑ mii sẽn lilli m nɑɑn n wʋsgẽ ne tʋʋm-sõmã, wẽng buud me kõn n tol n pɑɑm-mɑ. Mɑm kɑ bũmb a to rẽnda bugsd lɑ sũ-noɑɑgd sɩd-kõtbã yĩngɑ.

Yẽ lɑ sẽn nɑɑn yãmb n yiis yõ-yεng pʋgẽ wã, lɑ A nɑɑn ɑ pɑgã n yiis yõorẽ wã bʋɩl yĩng t'ɑ nɑ pɑam yɑm-gãɑg ne-ɑ. Lɑ ɑ sẽn wɑ n kẽ ne-ɑ wã ɑ rɩkɑ pʋg sẽn yɑɑ fɑɑgɑ, t'ɑ tɑll-ɑ n tʋgdẽ, lɑ ɑ sẽn wɑ n lebg zɩsgã b bõosɑ b Soɑb ɑ Wẽnd n yeele: ''Fo sã n kõ tõnd biig sẽn pid n tɑ, ɑd tõnd nɑ yɩ zɑɑmẽ-beoog pʋʋsdbɑ''.
Lɑ A sẽn wɑ n kõ-b biig sẽn yɑɑ sõmɑ wã b kẽesɑ ɑ pʋgẽ soɑben-zẽmes soolem (n pʋd-ɑ t'ɑ Hɑɑrs yɑmbɑ), lɑ Wẽnd zẽkɑ me n yi bãmb sẽn dɩkd n lɑgemd ne-A wã.
Bãmb rɩkdɑ sẽn kɑ nɑɑnd-b bɑɑ fɩ wã n lɑgemd ne Wẽnde tɩ B yɑool n nɑɑnɑ bãmbɑ?
Lɑ b kɑ tõe n sõng bãmbɑ lɑ b le kɑ tõe n sõng b mens me!
Lɑ yãmb sã n boond-b n tʋg so-tɩrg tũubu b kɑ tũud yãmb ye; zemɑ tɑɑbɑ yãmb sã n boond-bɑ mɑɑ y sĩndɑme.
